name: Turquoise Blue by Yuki Hirotani
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
Turquoise Blue is a versatile recipe that can be used with a variety of subjects and scenes, including portraits and snapshots. It achieves a fresh and translucent look. As contrast is slightly subdued, it is effective during bright daytime hours and for scenes in which the blue of the sky stands out. It can also be used on cloudy or rainy days. I hope you’ll give it a try.
